status_summary: H.R. 5463, the Choice Arrangement Act of 2025, was introduced 2025-09-18 and referred to Ways and Means, with no later action recorded on GovInfo through 2026-07-21; it would create employer-funded CHOICE arrangements tied to individual market coverage, a form of individual coverage HRA, and does not address association health plans or short-term plans. On 2025-08-07 the Labor, HHS and Treasury departments stated they would not prioritize enforcement of the 2024 short-term plan definition pending new rulemaking, an executive step that does not codify anything, and no proposed short-term plan rule appears in the Federal Register through 2026-10-16. Public Law 119-21 lists no health reimbursement arrangement provision in its Health subtitle table of contents, and no association health plan action was found.

timeline.event: The Departments of Labor, HHS and the Treasury stated they will not prioritize enforcement of the 2024 short-term, limited-duration insurance definition, including its notice provision, until new rulemaking takes effect, and announced intent to reconsider the definition through notice and comment.
H.R. 5463, the Choice Arrangement Act of 2025, was introduced and referred to the Committee on Ways and Means.
